notes: Opens «وبهذا الإسناد»: the names up to ابن أبي عمير are taken from prev1 (its chain_text); prev1 runs on to هشام بن سالم, but this text writes هشام itself, so the inherited part stops before him. How much is taken over is a reading, not certain.
«وغيرهما» is written as an unnamed co-transmitter; أبي عبد الله stands inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text.
